about:
Zibtek, a software development services firm, is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was founded in 2009 by entrepreneurs who had previously founded, built, and exited multiple ventures. They applied that experience to helping clients navigate digital transformation through custom software solutions.

The firm delivers full-cycle custom software development, including web application development, mobile app development, API development, microservices architecture, and ERP system development. It also provides staff augmentation, quality assurance and testing, DevOps, project management, and design services. Development teams are available onshore, nearshore, and offshore to align with client budgets and timelines.

Zibtek serves clients across sectors such as healthcare and safety, social media, productivity tools, and financial services. Notable engagements include building a workplace screening portal for FormFox, developing the private family social app Awsm (formerly Stoke), creating a cross-platform journaling application for Promptly Journals, and supplying scalable development resources for Academy Mortgage.

The company distinguishes itself through end-to-end product ownership, a practical agile methodology that emphasizes sprint-based delivery and continuous feedback, and a rigorous hiring process that yields autonomous yet communicative engineers. Clients receive a single point of contact paired with a project manager, and the firm's local presence in Salt Lake City enables on-site collaboration and faster turnaround.
